name: Andreas Waltenspiel
headline: Success comes from standing out not from fitting in! I help you to stand out. // Advisor, Challenger, B2B influencer.
summary:
With over 20 years of experience in the TV and Telco industry, I am passionate about connecting the dots and connecting people. As the Managing Director of Waltenspiel Management Consulting, I advise, consult, and challenge thought leaders and innovators to move to the next level and to look beyond the obvious. I also produce and moderate engaging and memorable events, both online and offline, that showcase the insights and learnings of senior executives and game changers in the media, telco, and pay TV sectors.

My mission is to contribute to the success of my clients and partners, who are exceptional in what they do and how they do things. They inspire, motivate, and lead with vision and passion. I help them to grow by providing them with alternative perspectives, cutting through the clutter, and connecting them with outstanding companies and operators that can deliver high-quality solutions and drive innovation. I work with a network of amazing artists and speakers, broadcast-grade live TV production, and proven suppliers with a track record and trust. I am always curious, eager to learn, and ready to challenge myself and others.
